sharing_verify: First, make sure the request is real. Contact the owner yourself and confirm it, if you can.

sharing_qr_mail: You can also post the QR code as a printed letter.
recover_browser: HOW TO RECOVER (MAIN METHOD, IN A BROWSER)
recover_step1: 1. Open recover.html in any modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
recover_share_loaded: YOUR PIECE IS ALREADY LOADED. The recovery tool holds your piece.
recover_no_html: If you do not have recover.html, open https://www.bitcoinbutlers.com/tools/inheritance/recover.html
recover_step2: 2. Load the encrypted file (MANIFEST.age) from this bundle:
recover_step2_drag: - Drag and drop it onto the page, or
recover_step2_click: - Click to browse and select it
recover_step2_embedded: 2. The encrypted data is already loaded. No action is needed.
recover_step2_embedded_hint: If you use a different recovery tool, drag this recover.html file onto it.
recover_step3: 3. Add the other pieces as you receive them:
recover_step3_drag: - Drag and drop README.txt files onto the page, or
recover_step3_paste: - Click the clipboard button and paste the piece text
recover_step4_auto: 4. When you have {0} pieces in total, recovery starts by itself.
recover_offline: Recovery works fully offline. No internet is needed.
recover_offline_tlock: Recovery needs a brief internet connection.
recover_cli_hint: If recover.html does not work, a technical person can build the command-line tool from the source at:

owner_steps_title: HOW TO SPEND THE BITCOIN (the owner wrote this)
owner_steps_intro: These are the owner's own words. They are not instructions from this tool.
chain_copy_intro: The same instructions are written on the Bitcoin chain, where they cannot be lost. The text below opens with any ONE of the wallet's keys. Keep it even if you never need it.
chain_copy_txid_blank: Not recorded here. The owner published after this archive was sealed, so the id is on their estate page instead. Without it, the text above still opens with one of the wallet's keys, but you must find the transaction yourself.
people_places_file_header:
WHERE THE KEYS ARE

The owner wrote this. It was sealed inside the encrypted archive, so it
appears only when enough guardians combine their pieces.
no_instructions: The owner did not leave instructions in this bundle. That was their choice. This bundle is not missing a page, and nothing has gone wrong. What it holds is your piece of the recovery key.
chain_copy_may_be_older: This copy cannot be changed once it is written, so it may be older than this bundle. If the two disagree, trust this bundle. Its date is in the footer below. The chain copy is here for the day every bundle is gone.
warning_message: The owner of this backup trusts you with this piece. Keep it somewhere safe. When a recovery is needed, you combine it with the other pieces.
recovery_steps_file_note: The owner wrote this. It was sealed inside the encrypted archive, so it appears only when enough guardians combine their pieces.
who_else: This bundle does not say. That is on purpose: a bundle travels, and a list of names travels with it. The owner kept that list with their will or estate papers, and it names you.
sharing_verify_estate: If the owner has died, a real request comes with their estate papers. One printed page there lists the guardians and names you. Ask to see it before you send your piece.
